d:
Bangladesh ki purv pradhanmantri shekh hasina ki sanbhavit vapsi ko lekar bangladesh men tanav barh raha hai. ravivar ko hasina ki parti aavami lig ke netaon aur samarthakon ne gopalganj men bare paimane par pradarshan kiya. is dauran parti karyalay par qabza, torphor, aagazni aur sarkon ko jam karne ki ghatnaen hueen. shekh hasina abhi bharat men hain aur bangladesh unke pratyarpan ki mang kar raha hai, jabki bharat ne abhi is par koee faisla nahin liya hai. dekhie ravivar ko bangladesh men kya kuchh huaa.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
